title_sq: Shitet apartament 1+1 i konvertuar ne 2+1 prane Kompleksit Rafaelo ne Fresk
description_sq:
Apartament 1+1 i konvertuar ne 2+1 per shitje, prane Kompleksit Rafaelo ne Fresk ne rrugen Sotir Caci.
Prona nuk shitet me kredi
Apartamenti ka siperfaqe totale 90m2, dhe neto 81.1 m2, apartamenti ka hapesira te bollshme
Ndodhet ne katin e 1 banimi dhe i 2 teknik ne nje pallati te ri e te mire administruar dhe i pajisur me ashensor, ne nje zone te mire te Tiranes, me akses te menjehershem me rrugen kryesore.
Eshte i organizuar me koridor qe ben shperndarjen e dhomave, sallon ndenje bashke me ambjentin e gatimit, dy dhoma gjumi, nje tualet.
Me orientim Jug- Perendim.
Zona ne te cilen ndodhet ofron facilitete te shumta dhe eshte nje zone mjaft e qete per te jetuar, duke qene nje mundesi shume e mire per banim dhe investim ,
Per arsye se kerkesat jane goxha te larta ne kete zone, pasi ka akses ne rruget kryesore dhe ne stacionet urbane.
Ka Dokumentacion te rregullt Hipotekor.
title_en: 1+1 apartment converted into 2+1 for sale near Rafaelo Complex in Fresk
description_en: 1+1 apartment converted to 2+1 for sale, near the Rafaelo Complex in Fresk on Sotir Caci street. The property is not sold on credit. The apartment has a total area of ​​90 m2, and a net area of ​​81.1 m2, the apartment has ample space. It is located on the 1st residential and 2nd technical floor in a new, well-managed building equipped with an elevator, in a good area of ​​Tirana, with immediate access to the main road. It is organized with a corridor that divides the rooms, a living room with a kitchen area, two bedrooms, a bathroom. With South-West orientation. The area in which it is located offers many facilities and is a quite quiet area to live in, being a very good opportunity for housing and investment, because the demands are quite high in this area, as it has access to the main roads and urban stations. Has regular Mortgage Documentation.
